calendar: ISO weeks: Monday 00:00 UTC to the following Monday 00:00 UTC, end exclusive. Edition id = ISO week id (2026-W42). The comparison week is the immediately preceding calendar week.

views.calendar: A complete calendar week, frozen when it passes the completeness checks.
views.developing: The current calendar week so far (Monday 00:00 UTC to the data cutoff), always labelled partial.
views.rolling7d: The seven days ending at the latest data cutoff; never mixed with calendar weeks.

historicalModes.as_known_then: Only observations with available_at <= the cutoff and memberships recorded by the cutoff. The cutoff of a frozen edition is its data cutoff; for a past week it can be set to the week end to show what was knowable then.
historicalModes.same_cohort: A declared fixed set (the members open at the comparison week's start, plus entrants named separately) measured in both weeks; members that died or were archived stay in the set with their (possibly zero or missing) values.
historicalModes.current_basket: Today's open members applied to both weeks retrospectively. Labelled as reconstructed; it is not what was known then.

completeness.fees: Every included venue (fee policy of the edition's financial run) has a settled value for all 7 days of the week; otherwise the fee total is partial and the missing venue-days are listed.
completeness.narrativeVolume: Every member in the mode's basket has a daily volume bar for every day it existed in the week; a missing bar makes that narrative's total partial.
completeness.runs: At least 5 daily research runs available within the week plus one run after it whose financial anchor reaches the week end.
completeness.publication: An edition is published as complete only when the fee and run checks pass; otherwise it is published as partial with the failing checks listed, or delayed.

aggregation.flows: Sum daily flows over the 7 days: venue fees, revenue, supply-side revenue, token volume.
aggregation.stocks: Never summed over time: holder counts, market caps, liquidity, prices. Reported as end-of-week (last observation at or before the week end) and start-of-week values.
aggregation.rolling: Rolling-24h and rolling-7d provider observations are never summed into weekly totals. Indexed launch counts are reported as the provider's rolling 7-day value nearest the week end, labelled with its own window.
aggregation.ratios: Period completions / period creations is a period ratio, not a cohort graduation probability, and can exceed 100%.
aggregation.fees: Covered fee subtotal uses the run's fee policy (non-overlapping streams only). Excluded venues are listed with reasons and shown individually, never added.
aggregation.multiLabel: A token in several narratives counts once in deduplicated market totals; per-narrative totals overlap and the overlap is disclosed.
aggregation.scopeChanges: When the included venue set or a narrative basket differs between the two weeks, the comparison is shown on the intersection and the scope change is listed; the denominator is never silently shrunk.

revisions: A frozen edition is never edited. A later build of the same week whose content differs (provider restatement, late data, correction) is written as revision r+1 with a list of what changed and why; earlier revisions stay published.
watch: Next-week watch conditions are generated deterministically from rule thresholds (registry narrativeRules and method thresholds), not from forecasts.
